importReadiness.recommendedEndpointPolicy: Use GPX endpoints for route continuity; model Naturum and Entré Syd facility clusters separately with their own coordinates.
importReadiness.suggestedDescription: This difficult section leaves Naturum at Skuleberget, descends toward Veåsand, climbs Getsvedjeberget and the Predikstolen viewpoint, then continues through mixed trail, gravel-road and forest terrain toward Entré Syd at Skuleskogens nationalpark. The section is short on dependable water after the Skuleberget/Naturum area, and protected-area rules change near both the start and endpoint.
